title: ailocalpack dependency whitelist
description: policy/dependencies.json of the registry: the executable components (mod loaders such as BepInEx) a pack may require, with the official release file per game platform and its SHA-256. Maintainers only. `ailocalpack index build` copies the entries into index.json (`dependencies`), so the app reads them with the pack list. Unknown properties are allowed (forward compatibility); a breaking change raises schemaVersion.

id.description: What a manifest's dependencies[].id names; unique.

layout.description: Where the release archive goes: the content of `from` (a folder inside the archive; default its root) into `into` (a folder of the game; default the game folder).

generated.description: Files and folders the component makes in the game folder when the game runs, deleted on uninstall when they weren't there before the install: a folder ends with '/' (removed when empty), '*' / '?' only in the last part of a file inside a folder.

version.description: What a manifest's dependencies[].version names; unique per dependency.

assets.description: The official release file per platform of the game build (a Windows build under Proton takes the Windows file).

url.description: The official release file: a ZIP archive.
